idea: Healthy habits (BATHROOM, bedtime): Baby Jimmy grins a funny chocolate grin ('Oh no! Chocolate on my teeth!') and Baby Ava gasps and points; Mommy Lily brings the toothbrushes with a tiny pea of toothpaste; Jimmy and Ava brush 'Up and down! Round and round!' (copy-me); they show shiny clean smiles, Ava points at her teeth and asks the viewer 'What do we brush?' (pause) – 'Our teeth! Shiny, clean teeth!'; lesson 'Morning and night, brush your teeth!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now with clean sparkling teeth and bye-bye waves.
title: Oh No! Chocolate on My Teeth! 🦷 Brush Your Teeth Song | Healthy Habits | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh no! Baby Jimmy has chocolate on his teeth! 🍫 Baby Ava gasps, Mommy Lily brings the toothbrushes, and together they brush, brush, brush their teeth until they are shiny and clean!

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Oh no! Chocolate on my teeth!"
👩 Mommy Lily brings the blue and the pink toothbrush
🪥 Brush up and down, round and round – brush along at home!
🤔 "What do we brush?" – can you answer?
✨ "Our teeth! Shiny, clean teeth!"
👋 Morning and night, brush your teeth! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: brushing teeth every morning and night • brush up and down, round and round • English words: brush, teeth, up and down, clean

A fun sing-along cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers about a healthy habit – brushing your teeth – with Baby Jimmy, Baby Ava and Mommy Lily.

Kids cartoon • Brush your teeth song • Healthy habits for kids • Nursery rhymes • Learn English for kids • Toddler learning • Bedtime routine
